checks.observation: V61 flags 77 reported duplicate groups / 154 rows in first 30000 FINAL; 5 polysemy examples, but no row-level evidence or decisions in V61.
checks.required_action: Pin raw duplicate group rows; resolve true polysemy vs same-sense alias without dropping source records; HOLD ambiguity.

checks.observation: V13 statuses NOT_REVIEWED 198030 and PROVISIONAL_EDIT 2114, Kaikki unreconciled 200144; none mean linguistic certification. MU-MAIN PASS_STRUCT 29846 is structural only.
